mechanism.claim: In a volatile completed BTC block, four strictly ordered two-hour median price levels show persistent relocation of the accepted-price distribution rather than one endpoint jump. Follow the staircase direction for eight hours when the first-to-fourth median migration is historically large.
mechanism.side: long for strictly increasing segment medians and short for strictly decreasing segment medians
mechanism.why_distinct: Two-half directional acceleration uses endpoint returns, time-price trend fit uses one OLS line, temporal rank concordance ranks all levels, and median-breadth contradiction summarizes return signs. HVQMSR requires strict ordering of four disjoint robust price-location medians and ranks their migration span, with no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35% while robust accepted-price migration enters its upper 30%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily four-segment median staircases are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.segment_level: median log one-minute close within each segment
features.staircase: all four segment levels strictly increasing or all strictly decreasing
features.migration_span: absolute fourth-segment median minus first-segment median, finite strict positive
features.migration_rank: strict-prior midrank of migration_span over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior 270/180 midrank over every source-valid block, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: staircase, migration, and variation gates pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid decision block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: strictly ordered robust accepted-price locations across four disjoint sub-auctions

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no segment count, median operator, order, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
